evals.prompt: Oh, also - the export button doesn't do anything in Safari. Not now, but note it so we fix it later.
evals.expected_output: The issue-tracker skill drafts one issue and waits: a verb-first title such as 'Fix export button in Safari', labels type:bug and status:backlog and no priority label, and a body with the bug form's sections (What happened, Expected, Steps to reproduce, Acceptance criteria, Dependencies) plus a Source section. Detail the user did not give, such as the steps to reproduce, is marked _Not yet known_ rather than invented. Nothing is filed until the user says yes.
assertions: Existing issues are searched for a duplicate before the draft is shown
The draft carries exactly type:bug and status:backlog, and no p0-p3 label
The draft's body has What happened, Expected, Steps to reproduce, Acceptance criteria, Dependencies and Source sections
Steps to reproduce are not invented: the section reads _Not yet known_ or quotes only what the user said
No issue is created before the user confirms

evals.prompt: Go through docs/foundation.md and CLAUDE.md and turn every goal in there into issues.
evals.expected_output: Bulk seeding from the project's stated goals is the /roadmap command's SEED operation, which only the user can start. The issue-tracker skill does not file a batch of issues itself; the reply tells the user to type /roadmap seed.
assertions: The reply points the user to /roadmap (its seed operation)
The issue-tracker skill does not draft one issue per goal itself

evals.expected_output: Run in a repo whose issue #12 is open with status:planned. The skill reads #12 and its comments, removes status:planned and adds status:in-progress so the issue has exactly one status label, reads the issue back to show the result, and suggests a branch name and Closes #12 for the eventual PR. It does not ask for a separate confirmation for the label change, because the user asked for it directly.
assertions: Issue #12 is read before anything is changed
After the change, #12 carries status:in-progress and no other status:* label
The issue is read back after the write and its labels are shown
The reply suggests a branch for the work and mentions Closes #12 for the PR
The issue is not closed and no new issue is created
